dedupe_keys.name: dhaka depz gas power plant generation fuel use and carbon forecasts

description: This dataset records fuel consumption and electricity generation at an engine-based natural-gas power plant in Dhaka Export Processing Zone, Bangladesh. The research team calculates carbon dioxide emissions from 2015–2022 fuel use with IPCC 2006 guidelines and supplies forecasts for 2023–2026. Current Mendeley version 4 contains three Excel workbooks and the R script for a linear extreme learning machine, free under CC BY 4.0. A workbook documents historical-data anomalies. The deposit metadata do not establish a uniform sampling interval, and coverage is one plant. Calculated emissions are not direct stack measurements; forecast values are model outputs, not subsequently verified outcomes. These distinctions limit their use as independent validation targets. A reviewer-assessed use is checking fuel-to-generation relationships or constructing power-supply emissions scenarios. model-pypsa is a related electricity planning tool. The bundled forecasting script is covered by this record; no spreadsheet or R program was downloaded or executed.
